note: The shipped Feral@60 is a pure Cat build whose RECOVERY still gates four rows on being a bear - Dire Bear Form and Bear Form at formId 8 and 5, and Frenzied Regeneration at 5 - while its combat list has no row that ever enters one, so all four are dead. This variant gives it the swap the sub-60 bands all carry (Dire Bear Form, 40-59 combat): shift at 35% and return to Cat only at 50%, so the swap is not undone on the next GCD. Frenzied Regeneration is re-gated from formId == 5 to == 8 because a 60 feral shifts into DIRE Bear, which is why the shipped row could never fire. Hibernate is dropped: enemyCount >= 2 makes it dead in a duel and it only lands on beasts and dragonkin anyway.
